limits: no L07 dispatcher lease or writer token
no exact pilot command signature, procedure binding, transaction owner or hook order proved
no authorized raw SQL/source/runtime opened or executed
no database mutation, lock test or legacy command dispatch
no product code, CI or current-head implementation test
no GitHub mutation or issue closure
objective: Require a command-specific transaction/hook/effect map before implementation or retry classification.

required_sections.name: identity_and_provenance
required_sections.required: action/contract/source/build/database IDs and exact handler/caller evidence

required_sections.name: typed_parameters
required_sections.required: names, types, bounds, nullability, server-derived fields and sensitive redaction

required_sections.name: datasets_and_fields
required_sections.required: every master/detail/join/read-only/derived dataset and writable field ownership

required_sections.name: authorization_state
required_sections.required: capability, tenant/company/branch/storehouse and business-state checks with timing

required_sections.name: transaction_owner
required_sections.required: caller versus procedure ownership, nested/savepoint behavior, isolation and XACT_ABORT disposition

required_sections.name: locks
required_sections.required: row/application resources, naming, order, timeout, owner/release and competing WinForms path

required_sections.name: hooks_triggers
required_sections.required: before/after/deferred hooks, triggers, order, failure behavior and mandatory versus optional effects

required_sections.name: completion
required_sections.required: authoritative success identity/state/reread and delayed mandatory-effect boundary

required_sections.name: failure_retry
required_sections.required: pre-dispatch rejection, rollback-proved retry, timeout/deadlock/worker-loss/late ACK and OutcomeUnknown policy

required_sections.name: audit_events
required_sections.required: business audit atomicity, post-commit outbox/invalidation, safe correlation and no secrets

review_rules: static hotspot presence is not a UI action binding
mixed XACT_ABORT cannot be normalized globally
no outer transaction until compatibility is proved
first DB commit may not be final business completion
no generic CRUD from table names
no silent compensation of committed financial/stock effects
core transaction commit is an intermediate fact when any mandatory effect remains; final success requires the complete action-specific predicate

completion_model.required_evidence: authorization, state, typed payload, provenance and reservation accepted
business transaction identity/commit observed; mandatory downstream effects still evaluated
durable effect identities and recovery ownership; client sees pending/unknown, never final success
every required hook/trigger/outbox/external effect accepted by its exact completion criterion
reread proves final business state and all mandatory completion predicates
